test_title: PYST 15: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If 20 men can complete a work in 48 days, then how many men should be employed to complete the same work in 40 days?
solution:
Formula:

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2, where

M1 and M2 = Number of men working on D1 and D2.

D1 and D2 = Days for which M1 and M2 worked respectively.

Calculations:

According to the question-

⇒ 20 × 48 = Men × 40

⇒ Men = 20 × 48over40 = 24

**∴ 24 men should be employed to complete the same work in 40 days.**
